statement: Ectopic expression of Oct4, Sox2 and Klf4 in mouse retinal ganglion cells restored youthful DNA-methylation patterns and transcriptomes, promoted axon regeneration after injury, and reversed vision loss in a glaucoma model and in aged mice, dependent on TET1/TET2.

context.model: optic nerve crush; glaucoma model; aged mice

measurement.assay: DNA methylation age; transcriptomics; axon regeneration; visual acuity
measurement.effect: reversal of vision loss in glaucoma and aged mice

replication.note: One group (Sinclair). Independent replication not cited here.
